notes: Refined existing stories to strengthen contract clarity, routing robustness, and facade alignment. No new IDs created per dedup rule.

change_log.value: Expanded schema to include units, routing status codes, cache_hit flag, and fallback_reason for deterministic downstream handling.
Clarified Google Routes integration including batching strategy, retry/backoff, cache layer expectations, and degraded-mode fallback (straight-line distance).
Explicitly requires stable response contract alignment with tool_models and inclusion in chat-ready payload.
Added deterministic tie-breaking and normalization requirements for multi-site trials (geo parsing, missing coordinates handling).
Expanded to include mocked Google Routes responses, cache validation, and degraded-mode assertions.

stories.title: Define Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured schema for trial proximity including distance (with units), travel duration (minutes), origin, destination, routing status codes, cache_hit indicator, and fallback_reason when routing fails. Contract must support deterministic downstream rendering and sorting.

stories.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Computation
stories.description: Implement logic to call Google Routes API to compute distance and travel time from user location to each clinical trial site, including batching, retry/backoff, rate-limit handling, and response caching. Provide degraded fallback using straight-line distance when API fails.

stories.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results returned to the chat layer, ensuring strict alignment with schema contract and tool_models for consistent API output.

stories.title: Integrate Proximity with Trial Location Extraction
stories.description: Apply proximity calculations across all extracted trial locations, normalize geographic inputs (address/lat-long), handle missing coordinates, and deterministically select the nearest site (distance primary, duration tie-breaker).

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
stories.description: Add tests covering distance/time computation, multi-site selection logic, malformed/missing locations, mocked Google Routes responses, cache behavior, degraded fallback mode, and end-to-end validation through the facade.
